# Assignment Documentation

For this assignment, I created a rough draft of the Qualtrics version of the **Survey of Educational Needs of MR Professionals**. I also shared the Qualtrics project with the instructor and reviewed the survey in Preview mode to document the beginning, middle, and ending areas of the survey.

## 1. Proof of Project Collaboration

The screenshot below documents that **Jae Jung** was added as a collaborator on the Qualtrics project. The available collaboration permissions shown in the project window are enabled.

![Proof that the Qualtrics survey was shared with Jae Jung.](data:image/png;base64,){fig-alt="Qualtrics collaboration window showing Jae Jung as a collaborator with permissions enabled." width="100%"}

## 2. Beginning of the Qualtrics Survey

The screenshot below shows the beginning of the survey in Preview mode. It includes the Cal Poly Pomona branding, the survey title, and the introductory information presented to participants.

![Beginning of the Qualtrics survey.](data:image/png;base64,){fig-alt="Beginning of the Qualtrics survey showing the Cal Poly Pomona logo, Market Research Educational Needs Survey title, and introductory text." width="100%"}

## 3. Middle of the Qualtrics Survey

The screenshot below shows a middle portion of the survey in **Part 2**, where respondents are asked about educational programs that may be valuable for the market research industry.

![Middle portion of the Qualtrics survey.](data:image/png;base64,){fig-alt="Part 2 of the Qualtrics survey showing questions about educational programs for the market research industry." width="100%"}

## 4. Ending Area of the Qualtrics Survey

The screenshot below shows the ending area of the survey in **Section 4**. This portion contains background questions and the final open-ended comment and contact-information items.

![Ending area of the Qualtrics survey.](data:image/png;base64,){fig-alt="Ending area of the Qualtrics survey showing Section 4 and the final comment and email questions." width="100%"}
